comments.body: Plan-review advisory (partial publish recovery), answered from release.yml: github_release edits an existing release instead of failing, and mcp_registry checks the registry for the version before each attempt, so after a PyPI success, re-running only the failed jobs (gh run rerun <run> --failed) completes the remaining targets. publish itself is never re-run for a version PyPI already holds; a bad artifact is yanked and fixed in a new patch version (docs/releasing.md Hard rules).

compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Cut rebar 0.14.0, a minor release, following docs/releasing.md. 0.13.1 (2026-08-30) is the latest on PyPI and GitHub Releases, and main carries 609 commits since then.

## Preconditions (checked 2026-10-29)
- `release.yml` publishes to PyPI and the MCP Registry through OIDC; no stored secret is needed. The `pypi` environment requires reviewer JoeOakhartNava and allows only `main`.
- The release-lane dependency advisory gate (`scripts/dependency_audit.py gate --lane release`) passes locally: no known vulnerabilities.
- Version is carried by pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and packages[]), tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json and uv.lock.

## Plan
1. Bump 0.13.1 -> 0.14.0 in pyproject.toml, server.json (both fields), and regenerate tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json (`python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update`) and uv.lock (`uv lock`), checking each diff changes only the version.
2. CHANGELOG.md: the `## [Unreleased]` section currently sits below `## [0.13.1]` and holds the curated post-0.13.1 entries. Retitle it `## [0.14.0] - <release date>`, move it above 0.13.1, open an empty `## [Unreleased]` at the top, add the 0.14.0 compare link, and curate entries for commits it does not yet cover.
3. docs/releasing.md step 1: add uv.lock to the files to bump (the 0.13.1 release commit bumped it, but the runbook omits it, so `uv sync --locked` fails for anyone following the runbook as written).
4. make verify, push to Gerrit, land at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1.
5. Dispatch `gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f version=0.14.0`, approve the pending `pypi` deployment, and watch the run to completion.
6. Confirm PyPI serves 0.14.0, the v0.14.0 GitHub Release exists and is Latest, and the MCP Registry lists 0.14.0; run `pypi-attestations verify pypi` on the wheel.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] pyproject.toml, server.json, api_surface_baseline.json and uv.lock all say 0.14.0, and the release commit is merged on main.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has `## [Unreleased]` at the top followed by `## [0.14.0]`.
- [ ] docs/releasing.md step 1 lists uv.lock.
- [ ] `https://pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/json` reports 0.14.0. [non-codebase]
  provenance: curl after the release run.
- [ ] GitHub Release v0.14.0 exists and is marked Latest. [non-codebase]
  provenance: `gh release view v0.14.0`.
- [ ] The MCP Registry lists io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.14.0. [non-codebase]
  provenance: registry search API after the run.

## File impact (expected)
- pyproject.toml
- server.json
- uv.lock
- tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json
- CHANGELOG.md
- docs/releasing.md

file_impact.reason: add uv.lock to the bump list
